audit.whatIsWrong: Jayce's hammer E is called "Thunderclap" in ten places across the content layer.
audit.why: Riot's name is Thundering Blow — Hammer Stance E, magic damage plus a short knockback. Thunderclap is not an ability in his kit, and it is the single most-repeated word on this page, so every sentence about the knockback names something that does not exist. The mechanic itself is right: it knocks you off your stick, so it must be baited before you commit.
audit.corrected: Thundering Blow used everywhere, with its 20s rank-1 cooldown added where the advice keys off it. The Counter-Strike-does-not-block-Shock-Blast interaction was already correct and is kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on the page, and "Grandmaster's Armor/MR steroid" in mid names the ultimate wrongly.
audit.why: His Q is on a shared 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 6 — that single timer is why levels 4-5 belong to him and why the level-6 and first-item all-ins exist at all. Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1, and the stance swap is 6s, so he is never more than six seconds from the other half of his kit.
audit.corrected: 16s Shock Blast and 20s Thundering Blow written into the stage whys, the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagreed with the packet: the page read Skill/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Skill/Jayce/Jayce.
audit.why: The packet chart is Jayce/Skill/Jax/Jayce/Jax/Jax/Skill and the mirror recorded exactly that string. The page's own whys agree with the packet, not with its sides: whys[0] calls level 1 "your worst window and his best", whys[2] gives you level 3, whys[3] swings 4-5 to him, whys[4] and whys[5] give you 6 and first item, whys[6] calls two items even.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart in both layers as one atomic group with ratings moved to match.

edits.before: Jayce starts ahead — at level 1 he has a ranged Shock Blast and long cannon autos to poke you while you're stuck on Leap Strike with no Counter Strike to dodge with, so eat the minimum and last-hit at max range. The lane flips when you hit 3: Q onto him, pop Counter Strike to dodge his autos, and recast for the stun — but Counter Strike does NOT block his Shock Blast, so you still have to sidestep that skillshot by hand. The catch is Thunderclap, his hammer-form E: it knocks you off your stick, so bait it out (or Q a minion past him) before you commit, or he just punts you away and pokes again.
edits.after: Jayce starts ahead — at level 1 he has a ranged Shock Blast and long cannon autos to poke you while you're stuck on Leap Strike with no Counter Strike to dodge with, so eat the minimum and last-hit at max range. The lane flips when you hit 3: Q onto him, pop Counter Strike to dodge his autos, and recast for the stun — but Counter Strike does NOT block his Shock Blast, so you still have to sidestep that skillshot by hand. The catch is Thundering Blow, his hammer-form E on 20s: it knocks you off your stick, so bait it (or Q a minion past him) before you commit, or he punts you away and pokes again.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are his, not yours — this is when his Shock-Blast-through-the-gate poke peaks and he can shred you between trades if you ever walk up with Counter Strike down. Don't chase that poke; wait for his cannon Q and Thunderclap to be on cooldown, then Q-in, dodge his autos into a stun, and juke the next Shock Blast on foot. At 6 it tilts back to you: Grandmaster's Armor/MR steroid soaks his cannon-into-hammer burst and the third-strike on-hit finishes him, so once Thunderclap is spent that's your clean all-in.

At 6 it tilts back to you: your R's Armor/MR steroid soaks the cannon-into-hammer burst and the third-strike on-hit finishes him, so once Thundering Blow is gone that's your clean all-in.

edits.before: This stays a coinflip into the late game — you still win any side-lane 1v1 where you land a Leap Strike, eat his autos with Counter Strike, and dodge into a stun, but Jayce never has to give you that fight. He's pure artillery now: Shock Blast poke and the gate-into-hammer burst from range, picking you and your team before you close. Press your Trinity Force all-ins at 6 and first item where his Thunderclap and cannon Q are committed; if it goes long, make him fight you on a side wave, never in the open where his poke owns the spacing.

notes: Wrong-name error, ten occurrences: his hammer E was written as "Thunderclap" throughout the content layer. The real ability is Thundering Blow (20s at rank 1). Also fixed "Grandmaster's Armor/MR steroid" in mid. Chart: all seven rows were wrong against the packet and the mirror; set to Jayce/Skill/Jax/Jayce/Jax/Jax/Skill as one group. STRUCTURAL, not fixed by me: the spikes array is out of chronological order — spikes[2].when is "Lvl 6" and spikes[3].when is "Lvl 4-5", so the page shows the level-6 spike before the level 4-5 one. Swapping them means rewriting both text and when fields as a pair and I did not want to reorder a rendered list without a ruling.
